nina: Quick heads-up: planning a narrow RBAC lockdown for priv-deploy keystore proxy tomorrow. Aim: eliminate broad svcacc decrypt scope.

rahul: What are the role changes?

nina: Replace `keystore-admin` with three roles: `keystore-read`, `keystore-decrypt`, `keystore-rotate`. Only `keystore-decrypt` and `keystore-rotate` can call KMS; rotate must go through outbound-proxy.

evan: Audit visibility? We need role->action mapping in logs for legal.

nina: We'll add `actor_role`, `svcacc_fingerprint`, and `trace_id` to the audit JSON. Full payload 90d, indexed metadata 2y.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Suggested canary 10% for 30m. Gate on `keystore.decrypt.error_rate` and `decrypt.p95`. Auto rollback on error_rate > 2x.

rahul: CVE FYI: patched yaml loader in keystore-agent. Roll restart risk: conntrack churn. Plan to do rolling restarts inside canary, bump `nf_conntrack_max` on nodes, and enable eBPF alerting.

evan: Emergency flow: 2-approver breakglass token (10m TTL) + pre-approved CIDR for admin bastion. All issuance logged.

nina: I'll open PRs for RBAC migration, netpol forcing proxy egress, agent patch with ephemeral leases, and runbook with breakglass automation. Target window: 03-27 02:30-04:30 UTC.

sec-bot: info: retention policy change queued for review.

nina: Thanks — will post PR links and checklist (metric gates: decrypt.p95, decrypt.fail_rate, audit.ingest.latency) when ready.
